title: Repair a RoleBinding Subject
prompt:
In namespace `cka-rbac2` the Role `pod-reader` grants `get` and `list` on Pods, but the RoleBinding points at the wrong subject: ServiceAccount `deployer2` has no access while `wrong-sa` does.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Make the ServiceAccount `deployer2` able to `get` and `list` Pods in `cka-rbac2` only.
2. Ensure the ServiceAccount `wrong-sa` has no access to those Pods.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: deployer2
  namespace: cka-rbac2
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: cka-rbac2
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: pod-reader-binding
  namespace: cka-rbac2
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: wrong-sa
  namespace: cka-rbac2
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

checks.failure_hint: Patch the RoleBinding subject to deployer2.
The Role grants list — fix the binding subject.
The binding currently points at wrong-sa — repoint it at deployer2.

reference_solution:
Repoint the binding subject.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-rbac2 patch rolebinding pod-reader-binding --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/subjects/0/name","value":"deployer2"}]'
```
hints: Compare the target ServiceAccount with `k -n cka-rbac2 get rolebinding pod-reader-binding -o yaml`.
Ensure the RoleBinding subject kind, name, and namespace point to ServiceAccount `deployer2` in `cka-rbac2`.
